analysis.description: The space is a modern Indian living room with a contemporary design, featuring a modular sectional sofa, a rounded coffee table, and decorative wall shelves. The use of marble countertops and open kitchen design reflects a blend of traditional and modern elements. The emphasis on comfort and functionality aligns with urban residential spaces in contemporary India.
